blocks.text: This chapter studies homeostasis: the mechanisms of thermoregulation and osmoregulation and the importance of keeping the internal environment steady for human health and survival.

blocks.title: Homeostasis
blocks.text: Homeostasis is the process by which living organisms keep a stable internal environment despite changes in their external environment, through many mechanisms working together.
Important processes of homeostasis are thermoregulation (control of body temperature), osmoregulation (control of water and solutes) and excretion (removal of metabolic wastes).
